purpose: Persist one exact development control-plane receipt for an admitted but inactive campaign.
audit_evidence_rule: Retain and validate the complete candidate, plan, four report bodies, and reconciliation; a summary cannot replace a report body.
identity_rule: The Controller candidate remains the canonical campaign identity. The audit checkpoint is accepted only through its exact content-addressed identity mapping and packet binding.
checkpoint_rule: A clean local checkpoint may be intentionally unpushed and nonterminal; that state is not release readiness.

persistence.write: Atomic, bounded, compare-and-swap protected, and lock-protected under the control-plane root.
persistence.readback: Read the written file, parse it as JSON, validate every retained body, and compare the exact receipt digest.

activation: This receipt does not start a campaign, spawn agents, write Product code, deploy, publish, push, merge, or activate 2.1rc.
